scenario: WIBTA if I don't let my friends stay in my hotel room after a rave. | My boyfriend and I are going to LED USA next month and I got us a hotel room to stay in that night. Now the hotel prices are kind of getting expensive, so they asked if I would let them stay in my room and split the cost. Now they're calling me selfish for not letting them stay in my room, telling me how much of a waste it is for me to spend money when I could just go home when they don't have the choice. My boyfriend is leaving the decision of letting them stay or not up to me since I paid for the hotel room. WIBTA if I didn't let them stay?
